decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass packaging substrates sit close to the firm's long-standing glass processing and patterning know-how, and its own R&D and EU research projects let it learn from early results and refine the ACT offer for growing 3D-integration and high-frequency markets.

Laser-based through-glass via structuring builds on the firm's established glass expertise, has a dedicated product page, and matches its strategy of investing in newer processing technologies for higher-value semiconductor applications, so management will keep developing it.
